scope: Opaque ordinary StaticMesh/SkeletalMesh Surface family; per material slot MID; global parameter association only
composition: BaseEmissive + RimColorContribution + AdditionalEmissiveContribution; no clamp; BaseColor and NormalTS remain separate
runtime: ComposePackage checks loaded recipes/ownership/types and returns a prebuilt material package; ApplyPackage creates MID; existing SetRimParameters performs frozen numeric validation and mapping. New backend inputs use native MID setters and require caller validation; recipe validation does not validate arbitrary native MID writes.

parameters.name: NPR_BaseColor
parameters.rule: RGB tint times BaseColorTexture; alpha ignored

parameters.name: NPR_BaseColorTexture
parameters.hardDomain: Nonvirtual Texture2D compatible with Color sampler
parameters.rule: Existing character source texture supplied explicitly; no automatic graph conversion

parameters.name: NPR_NormalTexture
parameters.hardDomain: Nonvirtual Texture2D with Normalmap compression and sRGB=false
parameters.rule: Normalized lerp from flat tangent normal to decoded normal

parameters.name: NPR_NormalStrength
parameters.rule: 0 is flat tangent normal, 1 is sampled tangent normal; Rim keeps its existing vertex-normal default

parameters.name: NPR_EmissiveTexture
parameters.hardDomain: Nonvirtual Texture2D compatible with Color sampler

parameters.name: NPR_EmissiveScale
parameters.rule: Finite nonnegative; zero is valid; independent from Rim

parameters.name: NPR_Roughness
parameters.rule: UE native roughness; not canonical SpecHalfAngleRad

parameters.name: NPR_Specular
parameters.rule: UE native specular; not a completed stylized specular effect

parameters.name: NPR_AdditionalEmissiveColor
parameters.rule: Minimal second additive module and extension contract; does not imply MatCap support

parameters.name: NPR_AdditionalEmissiveScale
parameters.rule: MF_NPRAdditiveColor output; changing this does not modify Rim or BaseEmissive

compatibility: All existing assets, Rim IDs/names/units/defaults and Outline backends are preserved. No automatic conversion of arbitrary source Material graphs, Material Layers, masked/translucent coverage, WPO or arbitrary runtime topology. Toon profile is the unchanged uncalibrated existing probe resource; native Toon quality is a separate gate.
profileIntegration: NotImplemented; no full semantic Style Profile resolver or cross-backend Execution Plan is introduced in this increment.
